record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace each tied unit-normalized item vector with normalize(v_i-mean_coordinates(v_i)), retaining 128 dimensions and zero padding. Removing each vector's coordinate mean may reduce a shared nuisance direction while preserving angular discrimination and tied input/output representations. Keep features, GRU topology, history policy, readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Apply the same embedding transformation in training and the generated predictor, with matching checkpoint metadata.
